blurb: Guests can enjoy daily wine tastings featuring flights of 3 wines selected from seasonal collections. The winery produces a variety of red and white wines, including icewines, from their 30-acre vineyard. The winery is family-owned and operated with a history dating back to 1723 in Germany.
extraNote: Cancellations may be made no later than 48 hours prior to your experience for a full credit to reschedule · Dogs allowed on property if leashed and outdoors at all times
